acceptance_contract.unit: each selected experiment case, never only the aggregate
acceptance_contract.quality: the candidate must satisfy the complete required answer contract
acceptance_contract.price: the candidate must have strictly lower price-equivalent cost; when request-level context class is unavailable, both frozen short- and long-context scenarios must be lower
acceptance_contract.speed: may be slower and is reported only as a secondary observation
acceptance_contract.failure_policy: one quality failure or non-decreasing price scenario stops expansion and rejects the candidate

baseline.identity_note: These hashes are obtained from Git history and match the currently installed source-query strategy; the installation copy is not used as repository source.

prior_evidence.quality_limit: No detached semantic audit exists for this raw result; price regression already disqualifies both cases.

prior_evidence.decision_limit: Candidate-only identities cannot be combined with another experiment's control to prove a strict price decrease.

final_probe.purpose: Test the smallest language- and project-independent text-first strategy before running the remaining matrix.

candidate_missing_required: the Webview initialization getSessions request and its line
sessionSelected null clearing the current session and messages
the source-only conclusion is not bounded away from VS Code transport or runtime-delivery proof

final_probe.reason: The candidate fails the complete quality contract and its short-context price-equivalent cost is higher. The lower long-context scenario and relaxed speed requirement cannot prove the required per-case quality and price improvement.

repository_decision.runtime_scope: No tools/srcq implementation, release, package, or installed Codex asset is rolled back or published.
repository_decision.reopen_condition: A future frozen paired A/B candidate must pass every representative case's complete quality contract and strictly lower both applicable price-equivalent scenarios before matrix expansion.

limitations: The final probe quality audit is a primary-agent audit; the price regression independently disqualifies the candidate.
The evidence covers only the declared C#, C++, and TypeScript snapshots with gpt-5.6-luna medium/default.
Speed was not used as a rejection criterion after the user relaxed it.
